tei:div.tei:p: lhag par bca' yig chen pos ji skad bshad pa ltar rtsa bzhi chang lngas ma gos pa zhig dang chos thun rnam pa gsum zhu zhing*/ so byang sngags gsum la nyams len ci nus su yod pa zhig rnal 'byor rang bca'/ ba rngas rang lcag skam po rang 'bar/ mkhas pas rang shes/ rang don rang gal che ba zhig dgos pa dang*/ sgos dam pa'i don du/ tshogs dus mchod kyi skabs 'dir/ phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyis sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung nas/ lha sngags phyag rgya/ phyi nang gsang gsum/ gdangs rol dbyangs gsum sogs gang sa phyogs mthus nas gra 'grigs po zhig byung na byin chags po zhig 'ong rgyu yin pas dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan/ rgyal ba'i bka' las/ shing phran stong gi dbus na tsandan gyi sdong po gcig khyad par 'phags pa bzhin du/ khyim gnas stong gi dbus na ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan thogs pa gcig gi kun spyod phra mo zhig gis khyad par du 'phags dgos par gsungs pa bzhin du ston pa'i rjes 'jug 'dren pa dge 'dun yin na thugs la bzhag dgos pa red lags/ ༈ da dus de ring gi skabs su dmigs gsal gyi bzung rgyu'i 'chang rgyu'i bca' bkod khrims su bshad na/ lung pa 'di la chu gcig babs pa de/ phu de na gangs gcig yod pa red/ gangs de na lha gcig yod pa red/ zer ba'i dpe ltar/ mi nga 'dra ba'i kha nas gtam gcig lab rgyu 'di/ bla ma dgon pa grwa tshang yongs kyi spyi don/ steng gi bla ma dang*/ 'og gi grwa tshang*/ yongs kyi spyi khrims/ rgyab brten bla ma lha dang chos skyong srung mas mdzad rgyu der lags/ bskos pa dge 'dun spyi yis mdzad/ de bskos pa'i mi rtsis bzhag gi rgyu mtshan legs byed bzang po'i ngo so dbugs dbyung gis bstod cing*/ nyes byed ngan pa'i nyes pa chad las kyis phab mkhan la dge skos bzhag nas 'dus pa'i khrims 'dus thog gi bshig na/ mi gcig dang gnyis kyis bsnog rgyu med pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i gtan tshigs kyi rgya ma 'di bstan pa dang sems can la lhag bsam rma med pa'i skyes bu dam pa de tsho'i lugs srol red lags/

༈ da sang nangs par sgrigs lam chen mo dbu tshugs nas bzung mtha' ma grol gyi bar du zhag bdun gyi bar du dgos rgyu'i khrims la/ 'o don tshan dang po tshogs khang gi sgo shub nas yar byon nas mar grol gyi ring la bla ma dbu mdzad mchod dpon gsum sogs las sne pa rnams kyi skabs der dgos nges brda sprod kyi gtam ma gtogs shog nyob kha phyes pa lta bu'i sob sob don med ngag 'khyal gyi lab gleng gi gtam ci dran gang dran bshad mi chog 'o don tshan gnyis pa gral nang bzhugasapa'i dus su lus mdun du bsgyur ba dang g.yas g.yon la sngas pa sogs ma yin pa'i bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan pa'i lus tshugs bsrang te gral gyi mdun ral gris bcad pa lta bu/ gral gyi rgyab a long 'thor ba lta bu las ci byung gang byung 'dug mi chog 'o don tshan gsum pa cho ga gsungs pa'i dus lo rgas pas gzhon pa dang*/ che bas chung ba/ bla ma grwa pa rnams zhal bsgos kyis skad ha cang che ba dang chung ba min pa'i gre ba'i nang nas rang babs ki skad lhod la ldir ba zhig btang mdzad de/ dal brel yang dbu mdzad sogs dang mthun pa'i skad sgrig zhig las/ ra skad lug skad mtho dman sna tshogs dang*/ sngon rgyug rgyab 'then sogs ci mos gang mos 'don mi chog 'o don tshan bzhi pa/ rdo rje dril bu/ sgrigs rnga/ rol mo dang*/ dung dmar/ rgya gling*/ dung dkar sogs yar len mar bzhag gang gi skabs na'ang kun gyi rang thob mnyam por 'khrol ba dang*/ dbu mdzad kyis sbub chol yang la 'jam pa snyan la 'gyur ba/ zhi drag gi nyams phyed cing*/ dal la skabs dod pa zhig gis/ rdor smin klong gsal so so la ma 'dres rang lugs dngos gtsang*/ seng chen kha 'thab/ bya rgod gshegs brdungs/ lce spyang seng skad sogs rang rang so so'i skabs ma nor ba zhig dgos/ dung

chen pas 'dor rgyang ṇir 'bud sogs rang skad kun ma 'dres shing*/ rol mo'i sna 'dren la zhi drag so so'i nyams ldan dang*/ rkang gling pas bzhi 'bud/ lnga 'bud/ bdun sogs so sor ma nor ba/ 'jam 'bol/ lhod pa'i rang skad dang*/ 'khyugs 'dar 'tsher ba'i phra skad dang*/ drag la ngar ba'i gdangs so so'i skabs thob dang*/ rgya gling pas spyan 'dren mchod pa sogs la snyan cing*/ 'bud mi 'bud rnam dbye yod pa dang*/ rnga brdung bas/ zhi drag so so'i brdung lugs phyed pas/ zur gsum brdung lhod gsum phab/ ldir snyan brjid gsum tshang bas rgya mtsho'i klong mi dkrug ri rab gling bzhi'i mtha' mi bskor/ ri thang mtshams kyi brag mi bshigs pa sogs gnad tshang ba dang*/ rnga mi brdung dus rnga dbyug ngo la glan/ rnga sa la bzhag dus sogs su lhod chags la 'jam po zhig las/ rgob chob 'ar 'ur song 'khrol/ rogs dang mi 'grigs pa ci 'dod gang 'dod byed mi chog 'o don tshan lnga pa mchod dpon rnams nas dkyil 'khor bshams bkod dang*/ mchod pa bca' rgyu dang*/ mchod rdzas bkram pa/ mchod me sbar rgyu/ mchod kha bsab rgyu/ mchod rdzas mchod skong rnams nyar tshags dam po byed rgyu las dka' 'tsher dang khag 'jog len byas pas mi 'ong zhing*/ mchod pa bca' rgyu sogs la kha bsnyad de/ nam yin phyi rol 'gro ba sogs ci lo gang lo byed mi chog 'o don tshan drug pa bla ma rnams dang khyad par dbu mdzad nas/ cho ga btang rgyu de ha cang yang mi brel ha cang yang mi dal bar tshig sngags gdangs phyag rgya rnams chad skyon med pa dang*/ cho ga de dag tshar 'gro gnad smin zhig las tshar thabs mgyogs thabs kho na dang zin bris sogs mi blta zhing pho tshod hob gzo dang mi shes na khri rin po che mkhan slob mdun mi zhu bar ci nyan gang nyan mi chog 'o don tshan bdun pa ser phreng sogs byon pa'i skabs su rgob chob sogs med par mgyogs thabs 'jam por byon cing*/

de'i skabs rtse zhwa gon na thams cad kyi gyon pa las 'ga' re phud pa sogs mi nyan cing*/ sgor bzhengs phyir grol ba'i dus su ral gri shub nas phyung ba lta bu/ nang du tshogs pa'i dus ral gri shub tu bsdu ba lta bu las 'gro ba'i dus rgyug 'chong lag rtsed sogs gzhan gyis ma dad pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba sogs mi rung ba dang*/ spyir byon pa'i skabs dang*/ khyad par ser sbreng sogs kyi skabs na mi re re bar na 'dom gang re yod nges las/ gnyis gshib dang spung thabs su 'gro mi nyan la/ nyin gung rgyab dwangs sang chen mo yun ring tsam las snga phyi dro'i tshogs bar rnams yun thag thung ba yin cing nam yin tshogs rjes mi sleb cing dbu mdzad kyi tshogs kyi tshig mgo bskul bas kyang mi sleb sogs ci shar gang shar de 'dra gtan nas bya mi chog// /
